task.name: Retail Single Config Page
task.summary: Create a single configuration page based on the downloaded sample-room React template.
task.business_goal: Provide an editable warehouse-region configuration page with a stable template-based implementation path.

prd.title: MVP placeholder PRD for single configuration page
prd.inline_text: The page should render warehouse region tabs and a ProConfig form. It should support entering edit mode, canceling edits, submitting configuration values, and showing loading state while configuration or warehouse data is being fetched.

frontend_td.title: Template implementation reference
frontend_td.local_path: ../../从 0 到 1 实现生码 harness工程.md

source.description: Downloaded sample-room code used as the main page-level reference.

reference_files.description: React list-page template that shows the sample-room annotation style and reusable hook boundaries.

reuse_notes: Keep the page-level composition pattern: hook-driven data, generated form field definitions, existing component library.
Preserve sample-room comments only when they help the generator remove optional blocks safely.

implementation.route_registry: Route integration file will be resolved in the route integration step
implementation.component_library: SSC UI React and react-pro-components where the local project already uses them
implementation.state_management: local React hooks following existing page pattern

business_rules: Seller ASN fields must react to allow_seller_create_and_update_asn_toggle.
Warehouse data loading and config loading must both block the form with a spinner.

forbidden: Do not add dependencies without approval.
Do not modify common request wrappers unless this task explicitly allows it.

functional: The page renders warehouse region tabs above the configuration form.
The page can enter edit mode, cancel edit mode, and submit through the hook-provided handlers.
Seller ASN form fields update when the ASN toggle value changes.
The form shows a large spinner while configuration data or warehouse data is loading.
data_contract: All request and response field mappings must come from PRD, TD, YAPI, or existing project code.
If API fields are not provided, the agent must stop and ask before wiring network calls.
manual_review: Confirm final route path and menu permission binding before release.

must_stop_when: Required API request or response fields are missing.
Target route or editable scope is unclear.
The requested change requires modifying files outside editable_scope.

decisions_needed: Final route registry file is intentionally deferred to the route integration step.
